title: General.
officialText:
Light-transmitting plastics shall be permitted to be used as wall panels in exterior walls, provided that the walls are
not required to have a fire-resistance rating and the installation conforms to the requirements of this section. Such panels shall be
erected and anchored on a foundation, waterproofed or otherwise protected from moisture absorption and sealed with a coat of mastic
or other approved waterproof coating. Light-transmitting plastic wall panels shall also comply with Section 2606.
Exception: Light-transmitting plastics shall not be used as wall panels in exterior walls in occupancies in Groups A-l, A-2, H, I-2
and I-3.
